notes.platform_files_summary: All 13 platform implementation classes (5 MacOS, 8 Windows) in batch 050 are dead code. They implement well-known interfaces (IPowerProfileProvider, ISensorBackend, IAutorunManager, ISingleInstanceManager, IConfigurationStore, IDispatcherService, IPlatformServices, IGpuBackend) but are never instantiated or registered in any DI container. The Windows hardware backends (GpuBackend, PowerProfileProvider, SensorBackend) are stubs with TODO comments indicating future implementation.
notes.plugin_abstractions_summary: The 6 plugin abstraction files (IAppStartupPlugin, IPlugin, IPluginConfiguration, IPluginHostContext, IPluginPage, PluginHostMode) in batch 051 are NOT dead code. They are actively used throughout the codebase (PluginManager, PluginBase, PluginRegistry, WPF pages, tests). Note: these interfaces exist in both UniversalDeviceToolkit.Plugins.Abstractions and UniversalDeviceToolkit.Lib.Plugins (legacy compatibility).
